evidence: The ALD cycle was as follows: NH3 gas was introduced into the reactor for 0.3–1 s. The pulse plasma of 7 kV peak to peak bias was also applied to the NH 3 gas for the same period. N2 purge and evacuation processes were carried on sequentially. After that, WF 6 gas was introduced for 0.3–1 s and N 2 purge and evacuation were done.
